answer: Standing decays sharply after 7 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The pigment decay curve is applied at each close, jetty records the drop, and knoll recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. Every extra alias adds 15 hours of verification and 10 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
